title: Florida Man Crashes Car And Runs With Rifle After Wild Police Chase
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Ocala, Florida — On May 10, 2025, at around 3:30 p.m., Ocala Police Department officers responded to a disturbance in the parking lot of the Wendy's located at 3001 E Silver Springs Blvd. An individual at the scene reportedly brandished a rifle. The suspect, identified as 25-year-old Voshon Brown, fled the scene in a white sedan, prompting a vehicle pursuit. Brown drove dangerously at high speeds in the wrong lane, hitting another vehicle. He ultimately crashed through a wooden fence at the Mustang Apartments complex, causing extensive property damage. 

Brown abandoned the vehicle after the crash and attempted to flee on foot while carrying a rifle. Officer Hernandez quickly followed and successfully apprehended Brown after deploying a taser. The rifle was recovered from underneath a parked car, and additional evidence, including marijuana and paraphernalia, was discovered in the suspect's vehicle. Brown is a convicted felon. Brown was transported to the hospital for evaluation following injuries sustained during the crash and later booked into the Marion County Jail. Officer Labbe arrested Brown on multiple charges, including aggravated assault, aggravated fleeing and eluding, possession of a firearm as a convicted felon, tampering with evidence, and several other charges.
